episodes.synopsis: Oh, no! As if getting up in the morning isn’t tough enough, Airi isn’t feeling well. How will Big Brother cheer her up?
episodes.title: A Sister-holic Brother and His Twin Sisters

episodes.synopsis: Cooking is more fun with friends! Maco and her buxom sister Coco visit and help Big Brother make breakfast.
episodes.title: Maco and Coco's Cooking Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: What a long day! After meeting Big Brother's friend Kisaki, the girls take turns working on their waitressing skills.
episodes.title: Kisaki's Kisa Kissa

episodes.synopsis: You never know where you're going to make a new friend! After an unexpected encounter, the gang help Ruha find the perfect snack.
episodes.title: Ravenous Ruha

episodes.synopsis: There's nothing more relaxing than an afternoon in a hot spring! After a quick dip, the gang enjoys some festival fun but someone is missing...
episodes.title: Everyone Goes to the Hot Springs?!

episodes.synopsis: Warm weather means it's time for a trip to the beach! While the gang enjoys playing in the ocean, Airi is hesitant to join them.
episodes.title: Everyone Goes to the Beach!

episodes.synopsis: There's a new restaurant in town! While the gang checks out the new eatery, Kisaki receives a challenge.
episodes.title: A Rival Appears?! Yamiry has Arrived!

episodes.synopsis: It's time to battle! Big Brother has to decide who's café is better: Kisaki's or Yamiry's.
episodes.title: Three Dark Christmas Contests!

episodes.synopsis: Happy New Year! Airi and Rise celebrate with a sweet cup of sake and Big Brother's zoni when unexpected visitors show up.
episodes.title: A Heart-pounding New Year's?! It's a Sweet Sake Panic!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a chocolate showdown! Yamiry and Kisaki battle over who has the best chocolate but Yamiry has a secret weapon.
episodes.title: A Valentine's Chocolate Showdown!

episodes.synopsis: It's time to celebrate! Even though it's Airi and Rise's special day, they want to help Big Brother by making him a yummy dinner.
episodes.title: Rise and Airi's Happy Birthday

episodes.synopsis: It's time to dance and sing! Kisaki recruits the girls into her pop group and while Airi and Rise are very nervous, Big Brother is there to cheer them on.
episodes.title: It's Official! We're kisakiss6!
